scenes.label: Hook

visual.prompt: A tall glass IT office tower in an Indian city at night, hundreds of windows glowing, streams of drawn dollar notes flowing out of the windows across a stylised world map toward the tower, dramatic and wide, filling the frame, no text

scenes.vo: India ne services bechkar sirf September mein 39,305 million dollar kamaye.

scenes.label: Setup

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear at a desk late evening, on a video call with foreign clients on a laptop, rows of colleagues with headsets in a busy Indian office behind her, focused mood, no text

scenes.vo: Services yaani cheezein nahi, kaam bechna. Software, call centre, consulting, videsh ke clients ke liye.

scenes.label: The choice

visual.prompt: A drawn scene of dollar notes arriving like birds and settling on a large sturdy rupee coin standing upright on a balance, the coin steady, warm daylight, no text

scenes.vo: Yeh kamai dollar mein aati hai, aur rupee ko sahara deti hai.

scenes.label: Why it feels right

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta relaxing on a sofa with a newspaper and a cup of chai, a calm petrol pump visible through the window, home loan papers on the table, relaxed contented mood, morning light, no text

scenes.vo: Rupee sambhla rahe, toh petrol aur EMI pe dabaav kam. Lagta hai sab theek hai.

scenes.label: What really happened

visual.prompt: A collage panel: a packed suitcase with airline tags, a TV showing a streaming app screen, a cargo ship at a port, each with small dollar notes flying out of India toward the sea, evening, no text

scenes.vo: Par hum bhi videsh ki services kharidte hain, trip, apps, shipping.

scenes.label: The cost

visual.prompt: Two drawn paths side by side: a fast runner carrying a bag of dollars running out of a gate, and a slower runner carrying dollars coming in, the outgoing runner clearly ahead, dusk, no text

scenes.vo: Usi mahine yeh kharcha pichhle saal se 12.6 percent badha. Aur hamari kamai isse dheemi badhi.

scenes.label: The twist

visual.prompt: A large water tank labelled with no text, filling from a pipe at the top while a wider tap at the bottom drains it faster, a young man watching thoughtfully, SG standing beside him calmly explaining, soft evening light, no text

scenes.vo: Matlab dollar aa rahe hain, par jaane ki raftaar tez hai. Har foreign subscription bhi dollar bahar le jaata hai. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

scenes.label: Send

visual.prompt: BHAI in a hoodie on a sofa surrounded by floating icons of many streaming and app subscriptions, looking slightly guilty, SISTER-like warm room light at night, playful mood, no text

scenes.vo: Yeh us bhai ko bhejo jo har mahine naya subscription le leta hai.

topic.summary: The values of exports and imports of services during September 2026 are presented in the following table.                        International Trade in Services                                      (US$ million)                          Month          Receipts (Exports)          Payments (Imports)                          July – 2026          38,253          (13.4)          20,606          (19.1)                          August – 2026          35,471          (13.7)          18,934          (21.4)                          September – 2026          39,305          (7.2)          20,097          (12.6)                          Note: (i) Data for July-September are provisional.            (ii) Figures in parentheses are growth rates over the corresponding month of the previous year, which have been revised on the basis of balance of payments statistics.                    Ajit Prasad                  Deputy General Manager        (Communications)        Press Release: 2026-2027/1415
